title: Kagamine Rin — Sparkling Performance〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One, two, three...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, wait.
Shouldn't you be using the other leg for that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah! Urgh, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Let's try that one more time, Minori.
I would like to check my steps as well since I'm not very familiar with them yet.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Shizuku... Thank you.
Let's perfect our moves and give Haruka and Airi a pleasant surprise!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. We'll have to catch up to them quickly, after all!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Minori, Shizuku!
How's it going?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We have been improving little by little because you let us borrow this place for practice. Thank you for that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You're most welcome!
Say, can I join in the dance practice?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Step out, hand behind, kick, tap, tap, and pose!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ah! Minori, that was perfect just now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, you did everything smoothly with no mistakes.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Did I really?! Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It must be because of the advice you gave me just now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? Hehe, I'm glad the advice worked, then.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm still unsure, though. I thought I had improved, but the choreography for this dance has parts that highlight each one of us individually...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What's your part like, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Like this.
I'll turn two rounds and glance over my shoulder.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! It looks so mature and pretty!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! Like a furtive glance from a goddess...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? Hehe, looks like I managed to pull it off, then.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Both of you have gotten so much better!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: By the way! Can you look at my dance routine too? Turn and...pose♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haugh?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How did you make that pose look so cute, Rin?! Th-That's not fair!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh my? This pose looks like something Airi used to do?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah! Now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It is! Airi taught me how to strike that pose just now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Airi's amazing, isn't she? Her dance moves are perfect, and she even thinks about where to place her fingers for the best poses!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know what you mean. Airi's dancing may simply seem energetic at first glance, but she puts a lot of thought into every move she makes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She always tries to think of the best way to make the fans feel more excited about what they're watching...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka said something like that too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Something about how we'll naturally get better at dancing if we focus on the feelings of those watching us, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm not at a level where I can think about such things yet, but I know I want to get there one day!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You will!
This SEKAI is the best proof of that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Remember that this SEKAI was born from all of your feelings?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Anyone whose feelings were beautiful enough to create this amazing SEKAI can definitely make their dreams come true!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's so strange. When Rin says it like that, it really does make me feel like our dreams are within easy reach.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm all pumped up and ready to take action now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Rin! Can you watch my dance routine one more time?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Sure!
Let's all do what we can to become the ideal idol!
